$description: Flamescope design tokens. Source of truth for web/style.css :root. SI-assisted: proposed with Claude (frontend-design and design-system skills), reviewed by the team.

semantics.flame: links, focus, SI answers, low-oxygen end of the evidence map
semantics.soot: high-oxygen end of the evidence map, warnings, unverified
semantics.verified: rows checked against source by a second person

color.map-scale: color-mix(in oklch, flame, soot) by oxygen fraction between the lowest and highest O2 in eligible runs

font.serif: Spectral (400, 500, 600) for headlines and reading text
font.sans: IBM Plex Sans Condensed (400, 500, 600) for UI, tables, IDs, numbers (tabular-nums)
